question: Which is a colourless, odourless gas of the alkane series of hydrocarbons with a chemical formula of C₃H₈?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Propane.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The **third member **of the **paraffin **series after **methane **and **ethane**, **propane **is a **colourless**, readily **liquefiable gaseous hydrocarbon **(compound of carbon and hydrogen).
 
• Propane has the **chemical formula C₃H₈.**
 
• It is commercially available as **liquid propane **or as key component of **liquefied petroleum gas **after being **isolated **in significant amounts from **natural gas**, **light crude oil**, and **oil-refinery gases (LPG). **
 
• The **ethylene **petrochemical industry relies heavily on **propane**, just like it does on ethane and other **paraffin hydrocarbons**.
 
• Another significant **byproduct**, **propylene**, is produced when propane is broken down in heated tubes to create **ethylene**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Butane:**

 
 
• At room temperature and atmospheric pressure, **butane **is gas.
 
• Butane is readily **liquefiable**, **highly flammable**, **colourless gas **that vaporises swiftly at ambient temperature.**​**
 
 
 
• **Pentane: **
 
 
• Five **carbon atoms **make up the **straight**-**chain alkane pentane**.
 
• It serves as a **refrigerant **and a **non-polar solvent**.
 
• It is both an **alkane **and a **volatile organic molecule**.**​**
 
 
 
• **Ethane:**
 
 
• The chemical formula for **ethane**, (paraffin series hydrocarbon with the properties of being colorless, odorless, and gaseous), is **C₂H₆.**
 
• The only **hydrocarbon **with a single **carbon-carbon bond** has the simplest structural **makeup**, and that is **ethane**.**​**
